snippet.title: Office After Hours | Launch Trailer (Steam PC)
snippet.description:
Office After Hours is available now on Steam 👉https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207300/Office_After_Hours
Spot scary and funny anomalies. Uncover hidden clues to escape an office where overwork turns strange and experiments happen more often than coffee breaks.
Get ready for 30 story based anomalies (40+ in total) and a mix of tension and humor.

• Developer: gameandcode
• Genre: Psychological Horror, Anomaly
• Platform: PC (Steam)
